operation.body:
### Goal

Implement category filtering on the feedback inbox (FR-004): users can narrow the list to one category or view all items.

### Acceptance criteria

- The inbox offers filter controls for **All**, `bug`, `feature request`, and `other` using labelled, keyboard-accessible controls with unique IDs.
- Selecting a category shows only feedback items in that category; **All** restores the full inbox ordering (newest first with deterministic tie-break, same as FR-002).
- When a filter yields no items, the user sees a clear empty-state message (not the unfiltered empty inbox copy).
- Changing category on an item (FR-003) and returning to the inbox respects the active filter.
- After a failed category update on show, returning to the inbox preserves the active filter when applicable.
- Automated tests cover filtering for each allowed category, **All**, and an empty filtered result at an appropriate boundary.
- Pull request contains exact `Closes #<this-issue-number>` and stays within this goal scope.

### Constraints

- Ruby on Rails, SQLite, server-rendered HTML; MIT license; no authentication.
- Build on FR-001–FR-003 behaviour on `main` (goals #9/#11/#13, PRs #10/#12/#14); do not regress create, validation, listing, or category update flows.
- Do not edit `docs/security-review.md` or implement goal #3 work.
- Report only checks that actually ran.

### Out of scope

- Restart persistence demo (FR-005), broad invalid-request handling beyond filter params (FR-006), full FR-007/FR-008 delivery, sample dataset, and demo recording.

### Relevant context

`Feedback::CATEGORIES` and inbox ordering exist on `main` at `6a2a4ff`. Index currently lists all items with no filter UI. Parent project #2 targets FR-001–FR-008 overall.
